manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: A ball is tossed upward beside a velocity-time graph. Gravity gives the same acceleration at the top.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.description: The ball's height, velocity arrow and graph marker move together. The acceleration stays -g at every instant, including the top.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. Change mass while paused to compare force.
